scope: Restore the Publish 14.1 Creature Handler emboldenpets command as a real-client, active-pet transaction with Focus-adjusted Mind cost, three-pool pet enhancement, per-pet cooldown, cleanup, and authenticated runtime evidence.

findings: The authoritative client table registers emboldenpets to emboldenPets/failPetBuff, with optional other targeting, a 1.5-second default, nonqueued dispatch, and visibility two; the retained callable lifecycle keeps ai.pet_master attached while a creature pet is active.
outdoors_creaturehandler_healing_02 grants emboldenpets, and the retained pet master plus emboldenPet buff row establish the original server-side ownership surface.

Pinned Core3 evidence requires a living player, an active living creature pet within 50 meters, Focus-adjusted base Mind cost 100, 15-percent Health/Action/Mind enhancement for 60 seconds, and a 300-second cooldown stored per eligible pet.
The command charges Mind only after an eligible pet accepts the buff; already-buffed or cooling-down pets are rejected without a resource charge.

eligibility: living active creature pet owned by the player
pet within 50 meters and neither already emboldened nor cooling down
current Mind strictly greater than the calculated cost
productionContract.cooldownStorage: pet.precuEmboldenCooldownUntil on the successfully buffed pet
productionContract.chargeOrdering: apply the buff and cooldown before deducting Mind; no eligible pet means no charge

liveFixture.ownerContextBridge: the attached fixture creates and tames its worrt from player context, then records the active pet, durable PCD, links, pre-buff maximum pools, and player Mind
liveFixture.fixtureIsolation: production telemetry is enabled only for the exact player OID, station ID, protocol, prepared root, and fixture pet
liveFixture.cleanupPolicy: remove buff and cooldown, destroy fixture pet/PCD/source, restore current and maximum Mind, Focus, skill points, fixture-granted skills, and the prior pet-master attachment, then prove repeated cleanup idempotence
liveFixture.recoveryPolicy: the exact reserved identity may remove exactly one orphaned worrt PCD only when no fixture root, skills, command, or fixture script remains; this repaired the pre-proof parser attempt without weakening ordinary cleanup

buildEvidence.currentSourceEvidenceRefreshedBy: Milestone 331 PRE-CU species-innate authority; emboldenPets semantics remain unchanged while the shared command, skill, and buff tables receive authenticated species-innate rows.

liveEvidence.poolDeltaPolicy: each maximum-pool delta equals integer truncation of 15 percent of its pre-buff value
liveEvidence.buffTimerObservation: getBuffTimeRemaining returned a positive absolute-style legacy value; duration 60 is independently locked by the compiled buff table and production apply call

included: authoritative command registration and Creature Handler ownership
production eligibility, Focus-adjusted Mind charge, three-pool buff, and per-pet cooldown
real-client nonqueued dispatch, active-pet/PCD linkage, cleanup, idempotence, and health
deferred: multiple simultaneous active pets where later server policy permits them
long-duration wall-clock expiry of the full cooldown
later-NGE pet class bonuses or expertise modifiers
